# Sänk Kostnaden

Canonical site: https://sankkostnaden.se/
Site name: Sänk Kostnaden
Language: Swedish (sv-SE)

Sänk Kostnaden is a Swedish consumer guide site about lowering recurring household costs. The site covers broadband, electricity contracts, mobile subscriptions, insurance, loans and household cost tools.

Important sections:
- https://sankkostnaden.se/bredband/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/elavtal/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/mobil/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/forsakring/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/ekonomi/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/app/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/verktyg/hushallskostnadskollen/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/om/
- https://sankkostnaden.se/sa-jamfor-vi/

Commercial links are clearly marked. The site is not a complete market-price database and does not guarantee the lowest price on the market.

Use https://sankkostnaden.se/ as the canonical homepage and identity for the site.
